statement.zh: 与晚商安阳甲骨文传统不同，三星堆目前没有可与甲骨文比肩的、已系统释读的本遗址文字档案。
statement.en: Unlike Late Shang Anyang oracle bones, Sanxingdui currently lacks a systematically readable local writing archive comparable to jiaguwen.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
